does: Loosens soft mascarpone with a cooled, sweet egg-yolk foam into a smooth, thick cream that holds its shape in a spoon. It is the cream of tiramisu and of other cold layered desserts.

intro.what: This dessert cream gently folds cooled sweet yolk foam into mascarpone.
intro.why: It teaches you to preserve a thick, smooth texture by cooling the foam and avoiding hard beating.

how: Cool the egg-yolk foam completely. A warm foam melts the cheese into a loose soup.
Put the mascarpone into a wide bowl and stir it with a spatula only until it is smooth. Never beat it hard.
Stir in a spoonful of the foam to loosen the cheese, then fold in the rest in small lots.
Stop as soon as the cream is smooth and even, with no streaks. Use it at once or keep it cold.

cues.text: The cream is smooth and glossy, with no grains and no streaks.
It holds a soft peak on the spatula and does not run.

mistakes.mistake: Beating the mascarpone hard, so that it turns grainy and then oily.
mistakes.fix: Stir it gently with a spatula, only until smooth.

mistakes.mistake: Mixing in a foam that is still warm, which thins the cheese.

quiz.question: What texture should the mascarpone cream have?
choices: Thick and smooth enough to hold a soft peak.
Thin enough to run from the spatula.
Grainy with visible pools of oil.
quiz.because: The cream must hold its shape for a layered dessert rather than run or split.

quiz.question: How should the yolk foam be prepared before mixing?
choices: Fold it in while still warm.
Warm it again before every addition.
quiz.because: Warm foam thins the mascarpone into a loose mixture.

quiz.question: Which appearance indicates mixing can stop?
choices: Visible foam streaks among cheese lumps.
Smooth, glossy cream without streaks or grains.
quiz.because: Stop when the cream is smooth and even rather than continuing to beat it.

quiz.question: Hard beating makes the mascarpone grainy and oily. What would you change next time?
choices: Stir gently only until smooth, then fold in the foam.
Beat faster to remove the grains.
Keep beating after all streaks disappear.
quiz.because: Hard beating can spoil the texture; gentle stirring and folding avoid overworking the cheese.

comes_after.why: The cream is made with the sweet yolk foam, which must be whisked and cooled first.

variant_of.differs: Nothing is whipped to hold air. A dense, soft cheese is loosened with a foam and combined with a spatula until smooth, and beating it hard would spoil it.
